name: General LGV Lemma: r×r Lindström-Gessel-Viennot Determinant

insights: Parent OQ03 (2878 lines, 0 axioms, 0 sorries) proves the 2×2 LGV lemma completely
2×2 LGV: non-intersecting path pairs = e(A1,B1)e(A2,B2) - e(A1,B2)e(A2,B1) = det[[e(Ai,Bj)]]
General r×r LGV: non-intersecting r-tuples = det[[e(Ai,Bj)]] for i,j = 1..r
Proof for r×r requires sign-reversing involution on r-tuples of paths
Mathlib has Matrix.det and Equiv.Perm infrastructure for the sign arguments
det_eq_signed_sum proof: use det(M)=det(Mᵀ) to convert column-form det_apply to row-form, then simp closes it
lgv_swap_sources: show submatrix equality, then Matrix.det_permute + Perm.sign_swap
lgv_repeated_source: Matrix.det_zero_of_row_eq handles equal rows directly
builtItems: det_eq_signed_sum: PROVED via det_transpose + simp (Leibniz formula bridge)
lgv_swap_sources: PROVED via Matrix.det_permute + sign_swap (row swap negation)
lgv_repeated_source: PROVED via Matrix.det_zero_of_row_eq (equal rows → det = 0)
gv_involution_cancellation: sorry (GV sign-reversing involution — the hard part)
